title: add runtime NVTX counters, microbench instrumentation, and perf dashboard
author: Ava Chen
description: Adds NVTX ranges, lightweight runtime counters, and microbenchmark harnesses to surface per-stage latency and allocation hotspots; introduces a Grafana dashboard and CI perf-check pipeline. Motivation: recent regression investigations and ongoing kernel/scheduler work lack consistent instrumentation to attribute token-level latency to kernel launches, KV cache hits, continuous batching, and scheduler queueing. This PR inserts NVTX ranges around key runtime stages (scheduler dispatch, continuous-batch aggregation, kv-cache lookup/insert, kernel enqueue/launch, postprocess/serialize), exposes Prometheus-style counters (per-model, per-device) and histograms, and adds a microbench suite (perf/microbench) that exercises small-sample KV cache and batching workloads with deterministic seeds. Also includes a Grafana dashboard JSON for perf team to iterate on and a CI perf-check workflow that runs the microbench on an isolated runner and compares baseline thresholds. The description below summarizes commits, changed areas, test matrix, review conversation highlights, and merge decisions.
commit_summary: Add NVTX scope helpers and macros (runtime/include/nvtx_scope.h)
Instrument scheduler: add NVTX ranges and counters around dispatch and queue wait (runtime/src/scheduler.cpp)
Instrument KV cache: measures hits, misses, insert latency and exposes histogram (runtime/src/kv_cache.cpp)
Wrap kernel enqueue/launch with NVTX and lightweight counters (runtime/src/kernel_launcher.cpp)
Add microbench harness and deterministic workloads (perf/microbench/kv_cache_bench.cpp, batching_bench.cpp)
Add Grafana dashboard JSON and CI perf-check pipeline (observability/grafana/nvtx-performance-dashboard.json, .github/workflows/perf-check.yml)
Docs and runbook: instrumentation guide and perf dashboard docs (docs/perf/instrumentation.md)
Fix unit test flake in scheduler tests by adding deterministic seeding and timeouts
review_comments: Diego Morales: Can we avoid NVTX in release builds by compile flag? Author: Yes, NVTX is guarded behind RUNTIME_NVTX macro and disabled by default in minimal builds.
Priya Singh: The KV cache histogram buckets look too coarse for tail latencies. Author: tightened buckets and added a 99.9pct bucket in the second commit.

Eleanor Park: Microbench CI may add flakiness to PR runs. Author: The perf-check workflow is opt-in for mainline and gated behind perf/label; we also added deterministic seeds and a separate isolated runner.

Diego Morales: Request to add per-model and per-device labels to counters for easier dashboarding. Author: Added model_id and device_id labels to Prometheus metrics in kv_cache and scheduler counters.
Priya Singh: small nits in docs. Author: addressed and pushed docs updates in the final commit.
ci_checks: perf-check: initial run flaky -> rerun -> pass
release_notes: Instrumentation: Added NVTX ranges and runtime counters for scheduler, KV cache, kernel launch and batching. Observability: Grafana dashboard for runtime NVTX/counters and CI perf-check workflow. Microbench: Deterministic KV cache and batching microbench harnesses for regression detection.
